name: Bundle Builder
description: Create and manage fixed and flexible product bundles with configurable and tiered discounts. Customers pick items on the storefront, see live totals, and add to cart with one click.

tables.name: bundles
tables.purpose: Master record for each merchant-created bundle, holding its type, discount configuration, Shopify resource references, and operational status.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal bundle identifier

columns.name: title
columns.purpose: merchant-facing bundle name

columns.name: bundle_type
columns.purpose: fixed: all items required; flexible: customer picks from pool

columns.name: required_count
columns.purpose: for flexible bundles: how many items the customer must choose

columns.name: discount_kind
columns.purpose: the type of discount applied to this bundle

columns.name: discount_value
columns.purpose: base discount in minor units (cents) when no tier rules override; for percentage kind this is basis points (100 = 1%)

columns.name: discount_currency
columns.purpose: ISO currency code for flat_amount discount_value; null for percentage and buy_x_get_y

columns.name: enabled
columns.purpose: merchant toggle for the bundle

columns.name: availability_status
columns.purpose: active, degraded (some components unavailable), or suspended (cannot be fulfilled)

columns.name: shopify_product_external_id
columns.purpose: the Shopify product bundle node numeric id

columns.name: shopify_product_gid
columns.purpose: the Shopify product bundle GID (gid://shopify/Product/...)

columns.name: shopify_discount_external_id
columns.purpose: the Shopify DiscountAutomaticNode numeric id

columns.name: shopify_discount_gid
columns.purpose: the Shopify DiscountAutomaticNode GID

columns.name: purchase_count
columns.purpose: running tally of orders that included this bundle

tables.name: bundle_components
tables.purpose: Each row is one allowed item slot in a bundle — either a whole product or a specific variant — with a flag for whether it is currently available.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal component identifier

columns.name: bundle_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.purpose: the parent bundle

columns.name: product_external_id
columns.purpose: the Shopify product numeric id this component belongs to

columns.name: variant_external_id
columns.purpose: null means the whole product; non-null pins to a specific variant

columns.name: position
columns.purpose: display ordering within the bundle

columns.name: is_available
columns.purpose: set false when the product is deleted or goes out of stock

tables.name: bundle_tier_rules
tables.purpose: Stores the tiered discount ladder for a bundle — each row is one tier (a minimum item count threshold and its discount value).

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal tier identifier

columns.name: bundle_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.purpose: the bundle this tier belongs to

columns.name: min_quantity
columns.purpose: minimum number of items to qualify for this tier

columns.name: discount_value
columns.purpose: discount amount in minor units or basis points for this tier

columns.name: position
columns.purpose: sort order ascending by min_quantity

tables.name: bundle_purchase_events
tables.purpose: Immutable log of every paid order that included a bundle, used to drive the purchase count on the admin table.

columns.name: id
columns.purpose: internal event identifier

columns.name: bundle_id
columns.constraints: NOT NULL REFERENCES bundles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
columns.purpose: the bundle that was purchased

columns.name: order_external_id
columns.purpose: the Shopify order numeric id

columns.name: discount_codes_applied
columns.purpose: serialised list of discount codes present on the order for double-application audit

admin.purpose: Return a paginated list of all bundles with summary fields for the admin table view.
Create a new fixed or flexible bundle with its discount configuration.
Edit any field on an existing bundle, triggering re-sync of the Shopify product bundle and discount.
Enable or disable a bundle, activating or deactivating its automatic discount in Shopify.
Delete a bundle record and remove its associated Shopify discount.
Add or replace the component items (products or specific variants) of a bundle.

widget.purpose: Return the full bundle definition for a given product page so the storefront widget can render the correct initial UI.
Receive the customer's item selections, validate them against the bundle rules, and return the cart payload the frontend should submit to Shopify Storefront API.
